title: GHANA COMMUNITY IN BELARUS HOLDS FIRST EXECUTIVE MEETING
content:
The newly elected Executive of the Ghana Community in Belarus successfully held its first executive meeting yesterday, August 25, 2026, in Minsk.

The meeting was chaired by the President, Dr. Sampson Kofi Asamoah ,and was attended by all executive members. The purpose of the meeting was to set the tone for the new administration and to deliberate on strategic plans for the welfare and growth of the community.

Key issues discussed included:

  • Reaching out and Strengthening unity among Ghanaians in Belarus
  • Welfare and support systems for members
  • Community engagement and cultural activities
  • Collaboration with relevant authorities and stakeholders
  • Plans for upcoming community programs

The executive reaffirmed its commitment to transparent, inclusive, and service-oriented leadership.

The Ghana Community in Belarus appreciates the continued support of its members and looks forward to a productive year of unity and progress.

id: GHANA CROWNED CHAMPIONS OF MINSK AFRICAN CUP OF NATIONS (MACON) 2026
title: GHANA CROWNED CHAMPIONS OF MINSK AFRICAN CUP OF NATIONS (MACON) 2026
content:
Ghana has once again proven its dominance in football after emerging as champions of the Minsk African Cup of Nations (MACON) 2026.

The tournament kicked off on July 11, 2026, bringing together five African football giants in Belarus — Ghana, Ivory Coast, Nigeria, Zimbabwe, and Cameroon — in a celebration of African unity, talent, and culture.

After weeks of thrilling matches, intense rivalry, and spectacular goals, the competition came to a grand finale on August 1, 2026. In a final filled with passion and pride, Ghana lifted the trophy as Champions of MACON 2026.

The Black Stars in Minsk, led by inspirational captain Seth Amoo Gottfried, displayed exceptional teamwork, discipline, and fighting spirit throughout the tournament.

This victory is more than just a trophy — it is a symbol of Ghanaian unity and excellence in the diaspora. The Ghana Community in Belarus congratulates the team, the technical bench, and all supporters who made this success possible.

Ghana — Champions of Africa in Minsk!

Nyame Bekyere. Ghana Abroad, Ghana Proud.
